data.name: Water Me & You
data.detailed_description:
Water Me & You

A cozy co-op adventure for two players 

A genre-blending experience combining the warmth and expression of cozy games with the excitement of a linear co-op adventure.

Work together, save the world but take your time

Take your time creating a home for a community of tiny woodlings - gather resources, build, customize and watch the woodling world grow at your own pace. When you’re ready, grab your partner and go on your next adventure! Explore, leap across platforms, solve puzzles and face challenges together, while always returning to the warmth of the world you’re building.

Story

Long after humanity vanished, the Woodlings, creatures of half-plant, half-animal origin, fought for centuries against pollution and the remnants of humanity. But with each generation their numbers dwindled, their thriving villages buried beneath the endless sand.

Far from Woodling civilization, two mysterious beings, Ripples and Sprout, held a fading gift that could stir dormant life. Their struggle led them to the abandoned mines, where they awakened the Wise One. Witnessing their gift, the Wise One was certain they were the spark needed to restore all of Woodling civilization, leading them towards the hidden world of the Woodlings. 

Cozy up  with you co-op partner and rebuild your village

Unwind and relax in a space you and your partner will be creating throughout your journey. Build, customize and nurture it into something uniquely yours!

Along the way, quests will guide you, offering not just resources and items, but memorable story moments.

Help the woodling world thrive as you unlock and upgrade your skills. Whether it’s crafting, farming, fishing, cooking or building, each profession will help your community flourish.

When you need a break, simply wander - explore hidden paths, and secret nooks without the pressure of rushing.

And while your village is a place of peace, you may sometimes need to defend it, keeping the woodlings safe from creatures prowling at its edges.

Grind on your own or do it together!

Whether you’re doing it solo or with your partner will be totally up to you, just don’t forget to grab them when it’s time to go on your next adventure! 

Go on Adventures when you’re ready

Each adventure grows the woodling word - returning home with new discoveries unlocks new villages, new activities, and exciting opportunities for both you and your partner.

Every adventure will reshape the way you play - master new abilities, forms, and mechanics that open up entirely new styles of cooperation.

Solve environmental puzzles that will challenge your teamwork and creativity. 

Alongside the main path, side quests will offer extra rewards, hidden lore, and all kinds of surprises, while rare collectibles might tempt explorers to look deeper into every corner.

At the end, the true challenge awaits. Epic boss encounters will test your skills, your teamwork, and your determination! 

Join Us

Discover what awaits in the hidden world of the Woodlings, and if you’d like to be part of the journey, join our Discord to get in on the development!

data.short_description: A cozy co-op adventure in which you play as a water or seed-like character, changing states and rebuilding a world left behind by humans.
data.supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Serbian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 5700 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 30fps at Low settings, 1080p
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6700 XT or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60fps at High settings, 1080p
